source: 759 Spiritual Intuition
target: 759 Intuitio Spiritualis

source: 759 Spiritual Intuition
target: 759 Intuitio Spiritualis

source: Beside the Knight of Swords lay a boundless lake, its quiet crimson waters shimmering under the moonlight of the night, occasionally stirred by a breeze.
target: Iuxta Eques Gladii iacebat lacus infinitus, cujus aquae purpureae lenes sub lumine lunari nocturno micabantur, interdum a tenue aura excitatae.

source: Lumian couldn’t help but lift his head to gaze upward, feeling the night sky, hung with a crimson moon, seemed closer and much clearer than usual.
target: Lumian non potuit non levare caput ut in caelum aspiceret, sentiens nocturnum caelum, in quo luna rubra appensa videbatur, propius atque clarius quam solito esse.

source: Even the stars, obscured by the moonlight, were faintly visible, dense as if forming a brilliant, vast river.
target: Etiam stellae, lumine lunae obtectae, vix conspicuae erant, tam spissae quasi flumen praeclarum ac immensum formantes.

source: A chilly wind blew past, and Lumian, dressed in a thick jacket, turned his attention back to the Knight of Swords and asked, “Aren’t you cold?”
target: Ventus frigidus praeteriecit, et Lumian, veste crassa indutus, animadvertit Eques Gladii et rogavit: “Nonne te frigore afficit?”

source: Although it was summer in the Southern Continent, their high altitude and thin air made it feel significantly colder, especially at night, with temperatures likely below 15 degrees Celsius.
target: Quamquam erat aestas in Continente Meridionali, altitudo eorum ac tenuus aer efficiebant ut sentiretur multo frigidior, praesertim nocte, cum temperatūra fere sub quindecim gradibus Celsius esset.

source: Originally gazing at the highland lake, the Knight of Swords turned to Lumian and said, “For me, temperature has lost its meaning, and besides, the cold suits me better.”
target: Primum ad lacum montanum aspiciens, Eques Gladii ad Lumian conversus dixit: “Mihi, temperatura significationem amisit, et praeterea frigus mihi magis convenit.”

source: “Is that so? Then, extreme temperatures over 100 degrees Celsius or close to absolute zero don’t affect you?” Lumian replied, his tone relaxed.
target: “Ita vero? Ergo temperaturas extremas, supra centum gradus Celsius aut prope ad nihilum absolutum, non te afficiunt?” respondit Lumian, tono quieto.

source: The Knight of Swords fell silent, his gaze dark, seemingly suppressing something, before Lumian steered the conversation back on track.
target: Eques Gladii silentium imposuit, vultu obscuro, quasi aliquid inhibens, antequam Lumian sermonem iterum ad rem redire curavit.

source: “What exactly is the matter?”
target: “Quid prorsus est quaestio?”

source: Without asking the pale-faced, simply dressed men and women around him to leave, the Knight of Swords spoke in a low voice, “This is the Raklev area of the former Highlands Kingdom. I would like you to help find someone here.”
target: Sine rogatu ut pallide vultos et simpliciter vestitos viros ac feminas circa eum discedere iuberet, Eques Gladii voce humili locutus est: “Hic est regio Raklev regni montanis pristini. Velim ut aliquem hic invenias.”

source: The Highlands Kingdom, known for its mummies across the Northern and Southern Continents? Lumian did not hide his confusion.
target: Regnum Montanum, notum propter mummias in Continentes Septentrionales et Meridionales? Lumian confusionem suam non celavit.

source: “What can you not find that I can?”
target: “Quid tu invenire non potes, quod ego invenire possim?”

source: Having worked together before, Lumian knew that the Knight of Swords, a holder of a Minor Arcana card and a Sequence 5 Wraith of the Prisoner pathway—mainly controlled by the Rose School of Thought with its splinter group, the temperance faction, joining the Church of The Fool—must have his reasons.
target: Collaboraverant iam ante, Lumian sciebat Eques Gladii, chartam Arcanae Minoris tenentem et umbram Sequenciae V in viā Captīvī—maxime ab Schola Rosae Cogitationis, cum factione temperantiae quae Ecclesiam Stulti adiungit—rationes suas habere debere.

source: Combining this information, Lumian guessed that the Knight of Swords was a member of the temperance faction, representing his faction within the Tarot Club, also serving Mr. Fool.
target: Coniunctis his notitiis, Lumian coniectatus est Eques Gladii membrum esse factionis temperantiae, quae suam partem intra Societatem Taroti repraesentabat et etiam Domino Stulti inserviebat.

source: Moreover, having seen a temperance faction Angel suspected of being a messenger of Mr. Fool, Lumian knew this organization was not weak, but rather strong, especially in divination, endowed with potent spiritual intuition.
target: Praeterea, cum Angelum factionis temperantiae, quem nuntium Domini Stulti esse suspicatus esset, videret, Lumian intellexit hanc ordinationem non esse infirmam sed potius validam, praesertim in divinatione, intuitu spirituali vehementi praedita.

source: Considering these, if the Knight of Swords truly needed to find a person, it would be simpler to request assistance directly from the temperance faction.
target: His rebus consideratis, si Eques Gladii vere aliquem invenire postularet, facilius esset auxilium directe ab hac factione temperantiae petere.

source: Is he thinking that it’s a waste of my promise if it’s not used?
target: Num putat promissum meum inutiliter esse, nisi id adhibetur?

source: Or, like me, do you prefer to rely on your own abilities and the goodwill you’ve accumulated to complete tasks, as a way to hone yourself?
target: An, sicut ego, mavis inniti propriis virtutibus atque colligta bona voluntate ad opera perficienda, quo te exerceas?

source: Ah, it’s more likely you’re relying on my mystical ability to attract evil god bestowed to locate the target…
target: Ah, verisimiliter inniti es facultati mysticae meae, quae deum maleficum allicere confert, ut metam invenias…

source: While Lumian made these guesses, the Knight of Swords, his voice suppressing his emotions and desires, said, “Someone’s spiritual intuition tells her that you can solve our current problem and provide the most effective help.”
target: Dum Lumian has coniecturas faciebat, Eques Gladii, cuius vox affectus atque desideria inhibebat, locutus est: “Intuitio spiritualis cuiusdam indicat illi te posse quaestionem nostram solvere atque auxilium efficacissimum praebere.”

source: A Wraith becomes a charlatan after becoming skilled at divination? Lumian thought sarcastically but didn’t inquire further.
target: Num umbra, postquam in arte divinatoria peritissima facta, charlatanum fit? Lumian sardonice cogitavit, sed ulterius non interrogavit.

source: “What do you need me to do?”
target: “Quid vis ut faciam?”

source: The Knight of Swords took a few steps forward.
target: Eques Gladii aliquot passus profectus est.

source: “Please allow me to introduce myself.
target: “Quaeso, permitte mihi me ipsum introducere.

source: My name is Maric, the ‘Knight of Swords’ of the Tarot Club’s Minor Arcana, and also a member of the temperance faction of the Church of The Fool.
target: Nomen mihi est Maric, “Eques Gladii” chartae Arcanae Minoris Societatis Taroti, atque etiam membrum factionis temperantiae Ecclesiae Stulti.

source: You’re aware of the origin of the temperance faction aren’t you?”
target: Novistine originem factionis temperantiae, nonne?

source: Lumian nodded and pointed at himself. “Lumian Lee.”
target: Lumian annuit et in se digito indicavit: “Lumian Lee.”

source: The Knight of Swords continued, “We are looking for an important member of the Primordial Moon faction within the indulgence faction.”
target: Eques Gladii continuavit: “Quaerimus membrum maximi momenti factionis Lunae Primordialis intra factionem indulgentiae.”

source: We… Lumian’s first reaction was to look around for any companions the Knight of Swords, Maric, might have.
target: Lumian, primo instinctu, circumspiciebat quaerens utrum quid comitum Eques Gladii, Maric, haberet.

source: But he found no one.
target: Sed neminem invenit.

source: As for the pale-faced men and women, he didn’t use his Eye of Calamity, simply observing their weaknesses and confirming they were all zombies.
target: Quoad viros et feminas faciei pallidae, Oculum Calamitatis non adhibuit, sed eorum infirmitates perscrutatus confirmavitque omnes esse zombos.

source: Lumian retracted his gaze and frowned.
target: Lumian oculos retraxit et frontem contraxit.

source: “The Primordial Moon faction?”
target: “Factionem Lunae Primordialis?”

source: Wasn’t the Rose School of Thought only known for the split between the indulgence and temperance factions? Where did the Primordial Moon faction come from?
target: Num Schola Rosae Cogitationis non tantum nota erat propter dissensionem inter factionem indulgentiae et temperantiae? Unde orta est Factionem Lunae Primordialis?

source: Hmm, from the series of events involving Hisoka and the Dream Festival, perhaps there was also a Devil faction within the Rose School of Thought…
target: Hmm, ex serie eventuum quae Hisoka et Festum Somniorum complectebantur, fortasse etiam intra Schola Rosae Cogitationis Factionem Diaboli exstabat…

source: Is this something learned from the Tamara family? Infinitely divisible…
target: Hocne ex familia Tamara didicisti? Divisibilitas infinita!

source: The Knight of Swords earnestly explained, “The Primordial Moon faction joined the indulgence faction later, originally a branch of the Life School of Thought; they grasp the Apothecary, which is also the Moon pathway. Later, guided by the Primordial Moon, they defected from the Life School of Thought and joined the Rose School of Thought.
target: Eques Gladii studiose explicavit: “Factionem Lunae Primordialis postea ad factionem indulgentiae se contulit, olim ramus Scholae Vitae; illi ‘Apothecarium’, quod etiam est via Lunae, apprehendunt. Postea, ducti a Luna Primordiali, a Schola Vitae defecerunt et Scholae Rosae se adiunxerunt.

source: Life School of Thought… Lumian’s head throbbed.
target: Schola Vitae… caput Lumiani pulsabat.

source: Why does this keep getting more complicated?
target: Cur haec semper magis complicantur?

source: And which secret organization is this now?
target: Et quaenam nunc societas secreta haec est?

source: Seemingly sensing his thoughts, the Knight of Swords, Maric, spoke succinctly, “The Life School of Thought primarily follows the Fate pathway and is now an ally of the Tarot Club. This matter has nothing to do with our current search.”
target: Quasi cogitata eius intuentem, Eques Gladii Maric succinte dixit: “Schola Vitae primarie per viam Fati se sequitur et nunc socia est Societati Taroti. Haec res ad quaesitum nostrum praesentem non attinet.”

source: Lumian nodded, signaling the Knight of Swords to stick to the main issue.
target: Lumian annuit, indicans Eques Gladii ut re principali perseveraret.

source: Aurore once said, “Do not add unnecessarily entities; if irrelevant, best leave it be to save energy.”
target: Aurore olim dixit: “Nolite entia supervacua addere; si sunt irrelevantia, melius est ea relinquere, ut energiam servetis.”

source: Glancing at the pristine, boundless lake, the Knight of Swords, Maric, said, “The member of the ‘Primordial Moon’ faction we’re looking for possesses a very important item—that is our target.”
target: Aspiciens lacum immaculatum et infinitum, Eques Gladii Maric dixit: “Membrum factionis ‘Lunae Primordialis’ quem quaerimus rem valde momenti possidet—id est propositum nostrum.”

source: “How are you so sure they are in, uh, the Raklev area?” Lumian engaged more seriously now.
target: “Quomodo ita certus es eos in area Raklev esse?” inquisivit Lumian iam serio.

source: The Knight of Swords paused for a few seconds before responding, “Two incidents here and some residual traces point to him, but we haven’t found him yet. Meanwhile, another event occurred that proves he’s still here, possibly right in Raklev City.”
target: Eques Gladii paucis secundis moratus est antequam responderet: “Duae hic res et nonnulla vestigia residua ad eum indicant, sed eum nondum invenimus. Interea, aliud factum evenit quod probat eum adhuc hic esse, fortasse in Urbe Raklev ipsa.”

source: “Is he from the Apothecary pathway?” Lumian asked cautiously.
target: “Num ex viā Apothecaria es?” inquisivit Lumian cautus.

source: The Knight of Swords gave a slight nod. “Yes.”
target: Eques Gladii leviter annuit: “Ita.”

source: “Which evil god is their Primordial Moon?” Lumian didn’t rush to ask about the incidents and the traces left behind.
target: “Quis deus malus est eorum Lunae Primordialis?” non festinavit Lumian de incidentibus atque vestigiis relictis quaerere.

source: The Knight of Swords’ expression turned grave for a moment.
target: Vultus Eques Gladii ad momentum gravis factus est.

source: “It’s likely an incarnation of the Great Mother, sometimes also known as the Mother Tree of Desire.”
target: “Verisimiliter incarnatio Magnae Matris est, quae etiam Mater Arboris Desiderii vocatur.”

source: “The Great Mother…” Lumian’s eyelids twitched, “Has the Primordial Moon’s important follower received a boon from the Primordial Moon, or should I say, the Great Mother?”
target: “Magna Mater…” palpebrae Lumiani tremuerunt, “Num sequens gravis Lunae Primordialis beneficium ab ea accepit, sive magis dicam, ab Magna Matre?”

source: “Possibly.” The Knight of Swords wasn’t too certain.
target: “Fortasse,” inquit Eques Gladii, non omnino certus.

source: A follower of the Great Mother receiving Her blessing would mean they could sense my Child of God lineage within a certain distance… The Knight of Swords hadn’t thought of asking for my help before; I had only recently received the lineage of Omebella, and his companion then had a strong spiritual intuition… Are they trying to lure out the target using my Child of God lineage? Lumian’s understanding of the situation became instantly clear.
target: Sequens Magnae Matris, benedictionem Eius accipiens, significaret se posse progeniem meam Filii Dei intra certam distantiam sentire; prius Eques Gladii auxilium meum petere non cogitaverat—nuper tantum progeniem Omebellae acceperam, et comes eius tum validam intuitionem spiritualem habebat. Num conantur metam edocere utens progenie meae Filii Dei? Intellectus Lumiani de re statim clarus factus est.

source: That person’s spiritual intuition is spot on!
target: Intuitio spiritualis illius personae penitus apta est!

source: The Knight of Swords regained his composure.
target: Eques Gladii iterum compositus fuit.

source: “That person is named Oxyto, a Sequence 4 Shaman King of the Apothecary pathway, a demigod. Don’t worry, we will discreetly provide you with protection.”
target: “Iste appellatur Oxyto, Sequenciae IV Rex Shaman viā Apothecariae, demideus. Noli solliciti esse; nos te secreto protegemus.”

source: While speaking, the Minor Arcana card holder bent down to pick up an oil painting from the ground, depicting a handsome young man in his twenties, his skin pale as if he hadn’t been exposed to sunlight for a long time, with deep features and slightly curly black hair cascading to his shoulders.
target: Dum loquebatur, tenens chartam Arcanae Minoris, se inclinavit ut tolleret picturam oleam ex terra, quae repraesentabat iuvenem virum formosum in annis viginti, cuius cutis pallida videbatur quasi diu sole non expositus, cum lineamentis profundis et capillis nigris paulo crispis ad humeros decurrentibus.

source: “This is a portrait of Oxyto,” the Knight of Swords briefly introduced.
target: “Hic est effigies Oxytoni,” breviter introduxit Eques Gladii.

source: “If there’s a boon, the target’s current appearance and gender might be uncertain…” Lumian pondered aloud, “Tell me about the incidents that occurred in the Raklev area and the significant traces left behind.”
target: “Si beneficium evenit, forma et sexus propositi fortasse incerti esse possunt…” meditatus inquit Lumian, “Narra mihi de incidentibus, qui in regione Raklev occurrerunt, atque de vestigiis gravibus relictis.”

source: The Knight of Swords pulled out a stack of papers from under his vest and handed them to Lumian, saying, “We first heard from some merchants about several occurrences of a full moon in Raklev City at times it shouldn’t appear…”
target: Eques Gladii fasciculum papyrorum de subia veste extraxit et Lumiano tradidit, dicens: “Primum a quibusdam mercatoribus audivimus de pluribus occurrenceibus lunae plenae in Urbe Raklev temporibus, quibus apparere non debet…”

source: “At the edge of Lake Dalsh, we discovered a buried ritual site where dozens of humans had become nourishment for the earth. Their abdomens had been torn open, and it seemed something had crawled out, but no related traces were found at the scene…”
target: “Ad marginem Lacus Dalsh invenimus locum ritualem sub terra positum, in quo plures homines cibus terrae facti erant. Abdomena eorum lacerata erant, et videbatur aliquid exinde exsurgere, sed nullae vestigia ad rem pertinentia in loco reperta sunt…”

source: Hearing this, Lumian suddenly recalled several scenes he had seen in Madame Pualis’s castle.
target: Hoc audito, Lumian statim recoluit varias scaenas quas in castello Dominae Pualis viderat.

source: He grimaced as he asked, “Were these humans both men and women?”
target: Vultu contrito rogavit: “Eramne hi homines tam viri quam feminae?”

source: “Yes,” the Knight of Swords seemed to anticipate his question and added proactively, “The males’ abdomens were also torn open.”
target: “Ita,” inquit Eques Gladii, quasi quaestionem praedicturus, addens: “Abdomena virorum quoque lacerata erant.”

source: He then pointed to the stack of papers in Lumian’s hands.
target: Tum ad fasciculum papyrorum in manibus Lumiani indicavit.

source: “More detailed information is in the documents.”
target: “Plura in documentis continentur.”

source: Lumian hummed in acknowledgment, pondering for a moment.
target: Lumian submisse hummavit, paulisper meditans.

source: “I might need my companions to assist me, can you protect them too?”
target: “Forsitan comites meos ad me adiuvandos mihi opus sit; potesne eos quoque protegere?”

source: “No problem, as long as you all stay within five kilometers of each other,” the Knight of Swords assured.
target: “Nulla difficultas, dummodo intra quinque chiliometra inter vos maneatis,” asseveravit Eques Gladii.

source: Lumian smiled.
target: Lumian risit.

source: “Then I’ll go back first to study the materials and make some preparations.”
target: “Tum primum redeam ut materiās studiose perlegam atque praeparationes faciam.”

source: In the Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702 on 9 Rue Orosai.
target: In Quartiere Cathédralis Commémorativae, Apartmentum 702 in via Orosai numero 9.

source: After listening to the Knight of Swords’ request, Franca scratched her head, puzzled.
target: Postquam petitionem Eques Gladii audivit, Franca caput scrobavit, perplexa.

source: “Forget the risk of searching for a demigod for a moment; I think you alone should be able to handle it. There’s limited help we can provide, as we don’t have the lineage of Omebella.”
target: “Oblita periculum quaerendi deo-semideum paulisper; puto te solum id curare posse. Auxilium nobis limitatum est, quoniam progeniem Omebellae non possidemus.”

source: Anthony, who had been called over, thought for a moment and said, “I could help cover up traces of the investigation, making those questioned forget they were ever asked.”
target: Anthony, qui vocatus erat, paulisper meditatus est et dixit: “Possem auxilium ferre ad tegenda vestigia inquisitionis, ita ut interrogati obliviscantur se unquam interrogatos fuisse.”

source: Jenna glanced at Lumian and said, “I think your real purpose isn’t to get our help.”
target: Jenna Lumian intuens dixit: “Cogito verum propositum tuum non esse nostram auxilium petere.”

source: Hearing this, Franca realized.
target: Audito hoc, Franca intellexit.

source: “You want to use this opportunity to train the team? You want to prepare this early?”
target: “Visne hoc uti ut turmam instituas? Velisne id antea praeparare?”

source: “Not too shabby.” Lumian chuckled, “The earlier you prepare for these things, the better, in case I’m forced to advance earlier than planned.”
target: “Non male.” subridens inquit Lumian, “Quo primum haec praeparas, eo melius, ne me coerceat ad antea procedendum quam destinatum.”

source: Franca thoughtfully said, “Then I’ll pass Jenna’s messenger summoning method to 007. When there are Mirror People clues, we’ll go back to Trier to follow up. And don’t forget the most important team member.”
target: Franca mente meditabunda dixit: “Tunc tradam methodum nuntiandi a Jenna ad 007. Cum indicia de Speculis Hominum apparebunt, redibimus ad Treveros ut sequamur, et ne obliviscaris membrum maximi momenti.”

source: “How could I forget?” Lumian laughed.
target: “Quomodo oblivisci possum?” risit Lumian.

source: Ludwig, who was enjoying a late‑night snack, saw his godfather enter the room and sit down across the dining table, flashing a smile at him.
target: Ludwig, qui cenam serotinam degustabat, vidit patrinum suum in conclave intrare et trans mensam convivii sedere, ei risum praebens.

source: Suddenly, the bread in his hands didn’t taste as good anymore.
target: Subito, panis in manibus eius non iam tam delectabilis gustu apparuit.
